This report has detailed four tests designed to determine as closely as possible, the chemical and physical properties of the shale sample from Statoil Well 30/6-2, 1715M. The sample shows the classic Swelling Clay properties. It contains high quantities of smectite (Montmorillonite) and disperses easily.
